items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: John Tumino had gotten my letter... Tumino said, Chicago. And John Temeeta say, 'You got to go in the Army in Chicago, because they have been looking for you and I didn't let you know about it.'

ctx.x: And after he went in, well, we had to get -- we had another tenor player, and so somehow or another, they had been looking for me and I didn't know it. John Tumino had gotten my letter.
Because Jay says they came and handcuffed him on the stand,
